# Harbison Standard

> Nathanael Harbison, REALTOR® (California DRE #02059393) helps buyers,
> sellers, and investors in Tehachapi, Bakersfield, and Kern County, California.
> Sold history, neighborhood guides, and direct contact. For-sale listings are paused.

This file describes the site for language models and answer engines. It is a
hand-written summary, not generated, and it is served from the site root at
/llms.txt so a crawler can find it without a sitemap lookup.

## Key facts

- **Agent:** Nathanael Harbison, REALTOR®
- **License:** California DRE #02059393
- **Phone / text:** (661) 472-7499
- **Email:** nate85.realtor@gmail.com
- **Areas served:** Tehachapi, Bakersfield, Newbury Park, California City,
  Stallion Springs, and the wider Kern County area
- **Service area is Kern County, California** — the office is not a walk-in
  storefront; contact is by phone, text, or the form on the contact page
- **Typical response time:** within 24 hours

## How the agent works

Three steps, stated the same way everywhere on the site: start with a
conversation, look at the details, then decide on the right move. The site
does not publish prices on services, does not run open houses by default, and
describes private and off-market sales as confidential, as-is transactions
that stay off the MLS and off the portals.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.harbisonstandard.com/): overview of the agent, services,
  service area, and FAQ.
- [Properties](https://www.harbisonstandard.com/properties): a coming-soon notice
  while no homes are listed for sale, plus a sold-and-closed list with addresses, prices, and dates.
- [Neighborhoods](https://www.harbisonstandard.com/areas): Tehachapi,
  Stallion Springs, Golden Hills, Cummings Valley, Bakersfield, Seven Oaks, and
  Stockdale — each with its current listings and a median asking price
  computed from those listings, at `/areas/<name>`.
- [About](https://www.harbisonstandard.com/about): background and working
  principles.
- [Contact](https://www.harbisonstandard.com/contact): phone, text, email, and
  an inquiry form. States the 24-hour response expectation.
- [Guides & resources](https://www.harbisonstandard.com/guides): index of the
  written guides.
- [Land](https://www.harbisonstandard.com/land): land and acreage in Kern
  County, and what different budgets buy.
- [Relocating to Kern County](https://www.harbisonstandard.com/relocate):
  moving to Bakersfield or Tehachapi from Los Angeles, including a
  budget comparison.
- [Why Tehachapi](https://www.harbisonstandard.com/why-tehachapi): the
  mountain community — elevation, climate, schools, cost, economy.
- [Sell privately](https://www.harbisonstandard.com/private-sale): selling
  without the MLS, Zillow, open houses, or a yard sign.
- [Off-market deals](https://www.harbisonstandard.com/off-market-deals):
  tax-defaulted, pre-foreclosure, probate, and FSBO properties, and how to get
  alerts before they reach the portals.

## Property pages

Each listing has its own page under `/property/<slug>` carrying the address,
city, ZIP, price, bedrooms, bathrooms, square footage, lot size where
published, MLS number where published, the full description, and features.
Active listings also show a monthly payment estimate; it is an
illustration from editable assumptions, not a quote. Sold properties are published too, with the status and closing
date on the page.

There is **no live listing feed** on this site. Prices and availability can
change; the property pages reflect the last update, and the site lists its own
last-modified date per listing. Verify price, status, and availability with the
agent before relying on it.

## Attribution and accuracy

Listing courtesy attribution remains with the original listing agent or
brokerage. Square footage, lot size, bedroom and bathroom counts, and MLS
numbers are published only where the source listing stated them — this site
does not estimate or infer them.
